items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I loved Uncle Harry. I thought he was a very sweet guy... Uncle Harry would tell me how great I was.

ctx.x: Right, my father’s . . . oh that’s right I should . . . do I . . . probably should name them. My father was the youngest of four brothers. Will or William. I think Harry Turner was the eldest, Uncle Harry. The next one was Ted, Edward, who was the father of Ted, Jr., my cousin. And the other one was Will, William. Out of these four brothers only came myself and my sister. Then my uncle Ted had the one son, Ted, Jr. That’s all I can think of. Maybe there’s somebody I forgot.
I’ll just develop that a little bit more. Does Ted, Jr., have any children?
